column1: A low-resolution breast tumor slide showing invasive ductal carcinoma with cohesive irregular glands, ducts, solid nests, or cords infiltrating desmoplastic stroma, heterogeneous tumor borders, and variable necrosis.

A low-resolution breast tumor slide showing invasive lobular carcinoma with diffuse poorly circumscribed infiltration, preserved background architecture, targetoid growth around ducts, and linear cords spreading through relatively sparse stroma.

A high-resolution breast tumor slide showing invasive ductal carcinoma with cohesive atypical epithelial cells, irregular tubule or gland formation, pleomorphic nuclei, prominent nucleoli, mitotic activity, and a fibrotic stromal response.

A high-resolution breast tumor slide showing invasive lobular carcinoma with small discohesive cells infiltrating in single-file or Indian-file patterns, minimal tubule formation, bland round nuclei, occasional signet-ring cells, and loss of cellular cohesion.
